lede: North Carolina carries the stronger underlying team rating — -0.4 against -1.4, a 1.0-point separation on a neutral field before home advantage, travel or rest.
EdgeDesk makes it Clemson -10.0 before any sportsbook number is consulted, with Clemson winning 74% of simulations.

Data confidence on this matchup is 41% — enough to publish, not enough to treat the exact margin as settled.
